summary.text: Dane Diehl is a Republican state representative who has represented Missouri House of Representatives District 125 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. A farmer and rancher from Butler, he chairs the Insurance Committee.

paragraphs.text: Diehl was born in Kansas City, Missouri, lives in Butler, and graduated from Butler R-V High School in 2009.
He earned a bachelor's degree in agriculture systems management from the University of Missouri-Columbia in 2013.
His career experience includes working as a farmer and rancher and as the district 4 director of the Missouri Soybean Association.
For the 2025-2026 session, he chaired the Insurance Committee and was also assigned to the Local Government Committee and the Legislative Review Committee.
